description: This source file defines a service class ProgressService for handling user progress data in a learning application. It includes a method to upsert (update or insert) user progress by communicating with an API endpoint via an ApiClient.

classes.name: ProgressService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing user progress data, including upserting progress details to the backend API.

methods.name: upsertProgress
methods.description: Asynchronously sends user progress (score) for a specific lesson and user to the backend API, returning the response as a map.
